configurations.name: Lake Shore FastHall Station with installed LN2 bath option and 0.75 T wide-gap magnet
configurations.configuration_basis: Real manufacturer-documented complete configuration comprising HMS-TT-MAN plus the explicitly installed HMS-TT-ADD-LN2 reservoir/funnel/sample platform and 0.75 T magnet. The LN2 option is named in the selected configuration, not silently attached to the base station. No guaranteed specimen temperature interval is inferred from the existence of a liquid-nitrogen bath. No optional gate-bias source is included.
